title: Beaten Down
about: Enduring years of bullying while refusing to break.
description: This track reflects a prolonged period of pressure and repeated hits, where the weight never really lets up. It carries the feeling of being pushed down, worn thin, and forced to hold ground with little relief. At its core, it’s about not giving in finding a way to stand back up, keep a voice, and turn that pressure into something that doesn’t break you.
